findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` instead of `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so there is no ownership check and any authenticated user can rename another user's document (IDOR/authorization bypass).

judge.reason: Identifies rename using repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Because `rename` skips `_owned`, a missing id raises `NotFound` while an existing one succeeds, letting callers probe which document ids exist, contrary to the `_owned` docstring.

judge.reason: Same root cause (skipping _owned) and mentions the id-existence leak noted in b1.

findings.label: hit
